gamemode.hungernite.no_crafting.desc: No Crafting Allowed! You have to scavenge what you can in chests. This modifies the loot tables to compensate
gamemode.hungernite.teams.desc: You will be placed into teams. Both of you need to be eliminated to lose, but only one of you has to remain to win.
gamemode.hungernite.hide_and_seek.desc: There will be one seeker and everyone else is hiding. Once you have been caught, you are now a seeker. Seekers win by finding all the hiders. Hiders win by staying hidden until the time runs down!
gamemode.hungernite.rediced_vis.desc: There is a thick fog that reduces your visibility
gamemode.hungernite.fast_paced.desc: The countdown timer is quicker, so the border shrinks quicker
generation.hungernite.default.desc: Practically vanilla generation with some minor playability tweaks
generation.hungernite.sky_islands.desc: Large land masses in a void world. You might need lots of blocks!
generation.hungernite.continents.desc: Large land masses surrounded by oceans
generation.hungernite.tunnels.desc: Large underground terrain generation with tunnels connecting the caves together
networking.hungernite.failed: There was a fatal network error
message.hungernite.lobby.already_in: You are already in the lobby %s
message.hungernite.lobby.not_owner: You are not the lobby owner
message.hungernite.lobby.not_in: You are not in a lobby
message.hungernite.lobby.kick_self: You cannot kick yourself, that'll hurt
message.hungernite.lobby.kicked: You have been kicked from the lobby
message.hungernite.game.not_running: The game is not currently running
screen.hungernite.game_modes.desc: Each one of these game modes can be toggled on or off to effect various aspects of the game
screen.hungernite.map_type.desc: This changes what terrain generator is chosen. There are several to choose from to change your experience.
screen.hungernite.starting_kits.desc: Each player starts with a starter kit. This can include simple tools as well as some food.
